about: The interactive hybrid, one short tour of all four walls: Equipment's three states, rapid selection, the rack scrolled to its end, the selector, empty keys and charges, Settings' controls with Epsilon's feed moved, the Journal's link round the corner, SHOW ON THE MAP and back, reduced motion, the pad. Scripted input for a capture, not hands-on.

steps.say: THE HYBRID: ORIGINAL STATION HARDWARE, KEPT ALIVE BY EPSILON -- EQUIPMENT: THE CABINET, ITS KEY SELECTOR, THE GRAFTED RACK

steps.mark: Equipment at rest: RMB's module seated, ON RMB; the window reads it

steps.say: RIGHT, THEN DOWN -- THE MODULE BEING READ IS PULLED; THE WINDOW SWAPS WHOLE, AT ONCE

steps.mark: inspected: ARC BOLT pulled, compared with what is on RMB

steps.say: RAPID DOWNS -- NOTHING WAITS FOR THE HARDWARE; NO WORD SQUASHES

steps.mark: mid-flight: modules sliding, the words already whole

steps.say: ENTER -- A LOCAL PREVIEW: PREVIEW · NOT SENT, AND THE KEY'S WINDOW SAYS SO

steps.mark: equipped, inspected, previewed: each its own

steps.say: THE WHEEL SCROLLS THE RACK A ROW A NOTCH, TO THE LAST ITEM; A CLICK READS IT

steps.mark: scrolled to the end; the last item read

steps.say: THE SELECTOR: UP AND DOWN (OR A CLICK, OR THE WHEEL) -- A DETENT A KEY. AN EMPTY KEY SAYS SO; Q KEEPS ITS CHARGES

steps.mark: an empty key: MMB -- nothing you hold goes on it
Q: CINDER CHARGE 2/3, on the key and in the rack

steps.say: E -- SETTINGS, THE MAINTENANCE SIDE: THE RACK'S RIBBON RUNS ON ROUND THE CORNER

steps.mark: the turn: harness and ribbon round the corner
Settings: salvaged boards; Epsilon's feed ends in the board's empty foot

steps.say: PRODUCTION'S OPTIONS AT THEIR REAL VALUES -- ARROWS, A CLICK OR A DRAG. EPSILON'S FEED TOUCHES NO VALUE

steps.mark: values in their windows; the feed clear of every one

steps.say: E -- THE JOURNAL: THE FOCUSED FINDING'S IVORY LINK RUNS ALONG THE HARNESS, ROUND THE CORNER

steps.mark: Journal: the focused finding's tag; the link leaves its end

steps.say: ENTER -- SHOW ON THE MAP: THE PORT FRAMES THE PLACE; THE WAY BACK IS ON THE GLASS

steps.mark: the turn to the Map: the link carries round the corner
the Map, framed on the passage the entry names

steps.say: ] AND ENTER -- A PLACE, AND ITS DETAIL ON A TAG FROM THE HARNESS
BACKSPACE -- FIRST THE DETAIL CLOSES, THEN YOUR VIEW COMES BACK, EXACTLY
REDUCED MOTION -- THE SAME INFORMATION AND ACTIONS, AS CUTS; THE SOUNDS STAY
A PAD -- THE PROMPTS, AND THE WINDOW'S OWN CONTROL, FOLLOW THE DEVICE IN HAND
